name: BERARDINA MASTROIANNI
bioAdditions: The San Mango parish burial index has the entry on 27 November 1672 (S1), matching the tree's death date.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).

sources.supports: Burial 27 Nov 1672: Berardina (indexed under Cicco), wife of Jeronimo Cicco (Index entry; the register image is on the same site's Google Drive, linked from https://www.italianparishrecords.org/search-by-region/calabria/catanzaro/san-mango-daquino.)
